papers.title: Visually guided in vivo single-cell electroporation for monitoring and manipulating mammalian hippocampal neurons.

pipeline_steps.technique: Plasmid preparation: transformation of Addgene-sourced plasmids into competent cells, antibiotic selection, and endotoxin-free silica-column purification

parameters.growth: 37 C overnight on antibiotic-selective LB agar, then LB broth overnight
parameters.purification_kit: NucleoBond Xtra Midi endotoxin-free plasmid DNA isolation kit (Macherey-Nagel)

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: purified endotoxin-free plasmid DNA

pipeline_steps.technique: Preparation of single-cell electroporation (SCE) solution: saline, fluorescent dye, and plasmid mixture, sonicated and filtered before pipet loading

parameters.saline: 155 mM potassium gluconate, 10 mM KCl, 10 mM HEPES, 4 mM KOH, pH 7.3, 316 mOsm

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: filtered SCE electroporation solution

pipeline_steps.technique: Pulling of long-taper borosilicate glass electroporation pipets with an optimized multi-stage puller protocol

parameters.glass: long-taper 2.0 mm OD, 1.16 mm ID borosilicate (Warner Instruments G200-3)

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: long-taper glass electroporation pipets
pipeline_steps.hardware: DMZ Universal Electrode Puller, 3.0-mm heating filament

pipeline_steps.technique: Chronic stereotaxic craniotomy and implantation of a custom stainless-steel SCE cannula with laser-cut glass window and silicone membrane over dorsal CA1

parameters.coordinates: -2.3 mm AP, 1.6 mm ML relative to bregma, ~30-40 degrees relative to the mediolateral axis

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: chronic optical/electroporation access implant over dorsal CA1
pipeline_steps.hardware: custom 316L stainless steel SCE cannula; titanium headpost; stereotaxic instrument (Kopf)

pipeline_steps.technique: Two-photon-guided in vivo single-cell electroporation (SCE) of CA1 pyramidal neurons: pipet navigated through the cannula's silicone membrane under two-photon excitation, tip resistance/pressure monitored to confirm cell contact, then plasmid delivery via voltage pulse

parameters.electroporation_pulse: -5 V, 100 Hz, 0.5 ms pulse width, 1 s duration
parameters.tip_resistance_targets: 4-7 MOhm in bath; 500 MOhm-1 GOhm during membrane penetration; 6-8 MOhm in brain; +1-1.5 MOhm on cell contact

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: single plasmid-expressing CA1 pyramidal neuron
pipeline_steps.hardware: two-photon resonant scanning microscope; micromanipulator (Scientifica PatchStar); MultiClamp 700B amplifier; Axon Digidata 1550B digitizer; ISO-Flex stimulus isolator
pipeline_steps.source_quote: the cell is electroporated (-5 V, 100 Hz, 0.5 ms pulse width, 1 s duration)

pipeline_steps.technique: Longitudinal two-photon imaging of the electroporated neuron's soma and dendrites across days to weeks to monitor expression level and cell health

parameters.viable_expression_window: up to ~2 months for inert fills; peak ~36-60 h for cytotoxic optogenetic constructs

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: single-plane time-series maximum-intensity projections of the electroporated cell

pipeline_steps.technique: Chronic in vivo two-photon functional imaging (calcium, voltage, or glutamate indicators) of the single electroporated neuron's soma and dendritic subcellular compartments in awake, behaving mice

parameters.compartments_imaged: soma, basal dendrites, apical tuft dendrites, individual spines

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: subcellular-resolution functional imaging traces from a single identified neuron

pipeline_steps.technique: Chronic targeted whole-cell patch-clamp recording from the SCE-labeled neuron via the same visually guided pipet approach (shadow-patch), performed weeks after implantation

parameters.characterization: voltage responses to positive and negative current steps in current-clamp mode

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: whole-cell current-clamp/voltage-clamp recordings from an identified single neuron

pipeline_steps.technique: Single-cell optogenetic manipulation of an SCE-labeled opsin-expressing neuron via widefield LED illumination, avoiding stimulation of neighboring opsin-expressing cells

parameters.readout: peristimulus zone fluorescence (Z-scored), pre/stim/post place-field induction

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: single-cell optogenetically evoked physiological/behavioral responses

pipeline_steps.technique: Single-starter-neuron monosynaptic rabies tracing: TVA-receptor and glycoprotein-complementation plasmids delivered to one CA1 pyramidal neuron by SCE, followed by EnvA-pseudotyped glycoprotein-deleted rabies virus injection to label presynaptic partners
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: labeled presynaptic input neurons to a single starter CA1 pyramidal cell

pipeline_steps.technique: Single-cell conditional gene manipulation via SCE-delivered Cre in floxed mice, combined with SCE-delivered organelle/structural reporters to image the resulting subcellular phenotype
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: single-cell genetically manipulated neuron with imaged subcellular organelle phenotype

papers.title: Movement-stabilized three-dimensional optical recordings of membrane potential changes and calcium dynamics in hippocampal CA1 dendrites.

pipeline_steps.technique: ROI mask generation and signal extraction from line-scan data

parameters.grouping: line scans corresponding to the same ROI grouped together
parameters.mask_generation: pixels with mean fluorescence across all frames exceeding the overall mean fluorescence included in the ROI mask
parameters.extraction: signal computed by averaging masked pixels for each frame

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: per-ROI raw fluorescence traces

pipeline_steps.technique: DeltaF/F calculation and voltage-event detection

parameters.df_f: computed via a 4-s rolling median followed by a custom denoising script
parameters.slow_event_detection: amplitude-based thresholding: interval labeled a slow event if it exceeds 3 SD at onset and drops below 0.5 SD at offset
parameters.fast_event_curation: fast events (putative spikes) curated manually using a custom Python/Plotly GUI, minimum inter-spike interval 10 ms, minimum spike duration 10 ms
parameters.burst_definition: large slow depolarizing events co-occurring with more than three fast events

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: DeltaF/F traces with classified slow events, fast events (spikes), and bursts

pipeline_steps.technique: Adaptive wavelet-threshold denoising of voltage traces

parameters.transform: Morlet wavelet transformation of DeltaF/F traces to capture time-frequency components of membrane-potential dynamics
parameters.clustering: wavelet coefficients normalized per frequency, PCA of temporal dynamics across frequency domains, optimal component count via the explained-variance elbow, followed by Ward's hierarchical clustering into 20 clusters with silhouette analysis to select the optimal cluster count; noise-dominated clusters discarded
parameters.thresholding: per-cluster threshold set at 2 SD above the moving average of wavelet coefficients; sub-threshold frames attenuated 50-100%
parameters.reconstruction: cleaned per-cluster wavelet coefficients converted back to fluorescence traces and recombined into a single denoised trace per ROI

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: denoised voltage fluorescence traces

pipeline_steps.technique: Cross-modal decoding of somatic voltage dynamics from dendritic voltage/calcium signals

parameters.feature_extraction: average event waveforms (soma and dendrite, voltage and calcium) centered on somatic voltage onset, time windows of +/-500 ms (voltage) or +/-2000 ms (calcium), decomposed into the first 5 principal components
parameters.model: fully connected feedforward neural network (two hidden layers, 64 units each, ReLU activation) trained separately per input modality (somatic calcium, dendritic calcium, dendritic voltage) to predict somatic voltage PC coefficients
parameters.evaluation: R2 between original and decoded PC coefficients via linear regression; reconstructed somatic voltage events correlated against originals, compared across path distance and dendritic branch order

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: PCA-decomposed somatic and dendritic voltage/calcium event waveforms
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: decoded somatic voltage event waveforms and decoding accuracy metrics

pipeline_steps.technique: Quantification of residual motion and 3D-RTMC performance validation

parameters.metrics: centroid displacement along x/y/z axes; frame-to-frame displacement via cross-correlation of chessboard frames; residual motion expressed in pixels and as power spectra over 0.001-100 Hz
parameters.significance_tests: Mann-Whitney U test on raw data and two-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov test on 100-bin histogrammed data (MATLAB 'histcounts') comparing power spectra with vs. without 3D-RTMC
parameters.reference_distance_analysis: linear regression of residual motion magnitude against z-distance and Euclidean distance from the reference cell

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: chessboard-scan frame time series with and without 3D-RTMC
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: residual motion magnitude and statistical comparisons of motion-correction performance

pipeline_steps.technique: Group-level statistical testing framework

parameters.reporting: exact sample sizes, definition of n, center (mean/median), and dispersion (SD/SEM) reported per figure legend

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: statistical significance results

papers.title: Parallel independent voltage computing along dendrites of CA3 pyramidal neurons

pipeline_steps.technique: Four-virus intersectional (Cre/FlpO-dependent) stereotaxic injection strategy for double-sparse, dual-color labeling of CA3 pyramidal neurons (JEDI3sub voltage indicator + tdTomato reference)
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: JEDI3sub/tdTomato dual-labeled CA3 pyramidal neurons
pipeline_steps.source_quote: achieve double-sparse labeling

pipeline_steps.technique: Imaging-window implantation over CA3 with four-channel linear silicon-probe implantation in contralateral CA1 and custom headpost fixation

parameters.probe_target: contralateral CA1, AP -2.2 mm, ML 2.75 mm, DV -1.0 mm, 45 degree angle
parameters.recovery: at least 1 week before behavior training

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: mouse prepared for imaging and LFP recording
pipeline_steps.hardware: four-channel linear silicon probe; custom headpost
pipeline_steps.source_quote: implanted with an imaging window

pipeline_steps.technique: In vivo 3D acousto-optical two-photon line-scan voltage imaging of soma and dendritic ROIs with real-time motion correction (RTMC)

parameters.laser_power: 30-70 mW after objective, scaled with depth
parameters.rois_per_cell: 5-14 ROIs per cell (15-28 lines per cell)

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: line-scan voltage-imaging traces from soma and dendritic ROIs
pipeline_steps.hardware: Femto3D-ATLAS AO microscope (Femtonics); Chameleon Ultra II Ti:sapphire laser (Coherent); 16x Nikon CFI75 0.8 NA objective
pipeline_steps.source_quote: Real Time Motion Correction (RTMC) using the FocusPinner platform

pipeline_steps.technique: Post-imaging structural z-stack acquisition and 3D dendritic morphological reconstruction to measure path distance of recorded ROIs from the soma
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: 3D path distance of each dendritic ROI from soma
pipeline_steps.source_quote: SNT software package to determine the 3D path distance

pipeline_steps.technique: VR-based goal-oriented spatial navigation/foraging task with fixed reward-location learning, reward-translocation and global-context-switch remapping manipulations
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: behavioral position/lap data aligned to imaging sessions
pipeline_steps.hardware: integrated two-photon microscope and virtual reality system
pipeline_steps.source_quote: water-restricted to ~85% of their original body weight

pipeline_steps.technique: Wide-band local field potential (LFP) acquisition in contralateral CA1

parameters.channel_selection: closest to stratum pyramidale by ripple amplitude

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: downsampled CA1 LFP traces
pipeline_steps.source_quote: recorded at 20 kHz using a digital acquisition system

pipeline_steps.technique: Sharp-wave ripple (SWR) detection from bandpass-filtered, Hilbert-transformed CA1 LFP with amplitude/duration thresholding and manual curation of false positives

parameters.state: awake immobile, wheel stopped, VR off

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: detected candidate SWR events
pipeline_steps.source_quote: LFPs after the Hilbert transform during awake immobile states

pipeline_steps.technique: Retro-orbital AAV/PHP.eB-CAG-tdTomato labeling of hippocampal CA2 for post hoc confirmation that imaged cells lie within CA3
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: CA2-labeled reference tissue for depth comparison against imaged ROIs
pipeline_steps.source_quote: AAV/PHP.eB-CAG-tdTomato was infused by retro-orbital injection

pipeline_steps.technique: Immunohistochemistry against the CA2-specific marker PCP4 with confocal tile-scan imaging for post hoc subregion confirmation
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: confocal fluorescence images of CA2 marker staining
pipeline_steps.hardware: Leica VT1200S vibratome; Nikon A1 confocal microscope, 10x 0.45 NA objective
pipeline_steps.source_quote: rabbit primary antibody against the CA2-specific marker PCP4

pipeline_steps.technique: Spatial-temporal independent component analysis (stICA)-based pixel selection and Delta-F/F signal extraction from line-scan ROI data

parameters.components: 5-10 independent temporal components after Gaussian smoothing

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: Delta-F/F fluorescence traces per ROI
pipeline_steps.source_quote: implemented spatial-temporal independent component analysis (stICA)

pipeline_steps.technique: Adaptive wavelet-coefficient thresholding to denoise fluorescence voltage traces, using Morlet wavelet decomposition and Ward's hierarchical clustering of waveform components

parameters.clustering: Ward's hierarchical clustering into 20 clusters, silhouette-selected optimal count
parameters.threshold: moving average + 2 s.d., per frequency-domain cluster

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: denoised Vm traces
pipeline_steps.source_quote: Ward's hierarchical clustering was applied to identify voltage event waveform patterns

pipeline_steps.technique: Fast-spike detection and peri-somatic timing classification (pre-AP, backpropagating AP, post-AP, isolated dendritic) via amplitude thresholding, template matching, and PCA-based clustering with manual curation
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: classified fast-spike events by timing relative to somatic AP
pipeline_steps.source_quote: curated using a semi-automated pipeline combining template matching

pipeline_steps.technique: PCA of coactive dendritic/somatic waveform features followed by Ward's hierarchical clustering to classify coactive dendritic subthreshold events into Driver/Follower/Synchronous functional subtypes

parameters.exclusion_window: events within 5 ms (near-zero lag) of somatic onset excluded as synchronous

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: coactive dendritic and somatic event waveforms
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: Driver/Follower/Synchronous dendritic event labels
pipeline_steps.source_quote: majorly identified as “Driver” and “Follower” dendritic events

pipeline_steps.technique: Place-field detection from lap-averaged, Gaussian-smoothed spatial tuning curves via bin-wise firing-rate thresholding

parameters.bins: 75 bins of 4 cm over the 3 m track
parameters.smoothing: Gaussian kernel, filter size 10 bins, s.d. = 2
parameters.field_threshold: > median + 1 s.d. of the tuning curve

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: identified place fields per ROI
pipeline_steps.source_quote: binning the 3 m-long VR track into 75 equal 4 cm bins

pipeline_steps.technique: Random-forest regression predicting lap-by-lap somatic place-field amplitude from preceding dendritic tuning-curve AUCs across five spatial intervals and path distance, evaluated by k-fold cross-validation

parameters.predictors: dendritic TC AUCs at 5 spatial intervals (60, 85, 100, 130, 155 cm from PF peak) + path distance from soma

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: predicted somatic place-field amplitude; feature importances
pipeline_steps.source_quote: k-fold cross-validation (80% for training, 20% for testing)

pipeline_steps.technique: TreeSHAP feature-attribution analysis of the random-forest model, followed by UMAP embedding and Ward's hierarchical clustering to identify spatially-selective ('IN'/'OUT') dendritic functional subtypes

parameters.embedding: 12-dimensional dendritic-feature/SHAP-value vectors projected to 3D via UMAP

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: random-forest model and its input features
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: SHAP dependence plots; dendritic functional-subtype clusters
pipeline_steps.source_quote: utilized TreeSHAP, a high-speed algorithm for estimating SHAP values

pipeline_steps.technique: Fully-connected feedforward neural network (2 hidden layers, 64 units each) decoding somatic event waveform PCA coefficients from Driver/Follower dendritic waveform PCA coefficients

parameters.input_features: first six PCs of Driver or Follower dendritic waveforms
parameters.evaluation: squared error per event; mean squared error per dendrite

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: decoded somatic waveform PCA coefficients
pipeline_steps.source_quote: fully connected FNN consisting of two hidden layers with 64 units

pipeline_steps.technique: Lap-by-lap tuning-curve classification as familiar or novel via Pearson correlation to somatic reference templates with a margin criterion
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: per-lap familiar/novel tuning-curve classification
pipeline_steps.source_quote: A margin criterion (Δr > 0.3) was applied

pipeline_steps.technique: Sigmoid-function fitting of lap-by-lap tuning-similarity envelope traces (bounded nonlinear least-squares with grid-search initialization) to estimate the lap of remapping initiation

parameters.fit_method: bounded nonlinear least-squares, grid search over initialization parameters
parameters.reward_translocation_criterion: earliest post-switch lap where fitted curve falls below 10% of dynamic range
parameters.context_switch_criterion: earliest lap where correlation to novel TC is positive, has positive first derivative, and exceeds the mean correlation

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: lap-by-lap correlation matrix to reference tuning curves
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: lap number of remapping initiation per ROI
pipeline_steps.source_quote: fit with a four-parameter sigmoid function

pipeline_steps.technique: Non-negative matrix factorization (NMF) decomposition of lap-by-lap somatic/dendritic spatial tuning dynamics into basis tuning patterns, with latent-space clustering into four remapping epochs (Familiar, Before, During, Remapped)
pipeline_steps.input_data_type: lap-by-lap somatic and dendritic tuning-curve dynamics
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: latent embedding and remapping-epoch trajectories
pipeline_steps.source_quote: to decompose the tuning dynamics of each lap

pipeline_steps.technique: Two-sided inferential statistics with ANOVA and Tukey post hoc correction for multiple comparisons; box plots report median/IQR and bar plots report mean +/- s.e.m.
pipeline_steps.source_quote: Tukey’s test was used post hoc
